zero_allocation_chapters: The Tale of Custard the Dragon
selection_rule: A production question is eligible only if its chapter, mark value, syllabus status, answer key and provenance are validated. Chapter presence alone is insufficient.
choice_rule: Respect the supplied blueprint note: one choice each in 2M and 3M; four choice questions in 4M; two choice questions in 5M. Exact paper numbering/order is not specified by this source.
rtc_quote_policy: RTC and Quote-from-Memory are not independent blueprint categories. They may be used only as formats mapped to an allocated chapter/mark slot.

source_flag.issue: q_4m=1 while total_marks=3 in the transcribed source data

pyq_policy: Final, Mid-term and Supplementary/Exam-2/Exam-3 papers are evidence for recurrence and style, not automatic replacements for blueprint allocation. Preserve provenance.
final_gate: Do not label a generated paper production-ready until every selected question passes chapter+mark+answer+provenance+duplicate checks and the complete paper recomputes to 47 questions/100 marks.
next_build: PYQ recurrence mining and final candidate selection; no additional architecture required.
